controls: Correlation generated by the server; client-provided value is ignored.
Method labels use a bounded allowlist; route is the registered ServeMux template, not raw URL or path parameters.
No request/response body, query, credentials, cookies, peer IP or user identity is logged.
Existing fixed-code panic event is correlated without logging exception value.
httpsnoop v1.1.0 was already pinned in go.mod/go.sum and is now a direct dependency; ResponseWriter capabilities are preserved.

cases: registered route with private path/query/body/headers excluded
unknown URL redacted to fallback pattern

limits: No Flutter diagnostic correlation implementation, pool/SQL telemetry, metrics store, trace sampling, retention or alerts delivered by this increment.
One structured completion event per request at info level; volume and log cost must be measured before external exposure. No log collector/storage was provisioned.
No benchmark, real user journey or performance capacity claim. Story029 remains open.
